# P37.14 — Statute-seeded records leads (row 436)

`implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/436_P37.14__statute-seeded-records-leads.md live_verification=false` · manifest row 436 · Round 11 / P37 (sub-round 11D) · depends P35.10 · `Changelog: yes`

## What this is

- **State reporting mandates are records-acquisition leads, never data feeds (SIG-INGEST-025a).** `tasks.statute_leads` + the committed `data/statute_leads.toml` (`sig.statute-leads/1`) emit exactly one output per `future_statutory_disclosure_*` duty the `statute_seed/2` asset names — a `StatuteRecordsLead` gap row for a commenced duty whose mandated record is requestable (VA §2.2-5517 I/J/K, AL 265-X-6, AR 12 CAR 150-103(f), UT 77-23e-106(3)(a)) or a `CoverageRecord` — `not_applicable` while first reports are not yet due (NM 2027-04-01, the registry rows' own lawful-absence rule) and `not_researched` while the mandate itself is unverified (MN HF 3198, contingent — a bill is not an appropriation). The seed↔table↔registry join is **fail-closed**: a seed duty with no leads row or a row naming an unregistered duty is an error, never a skipped mandate — "each statute duty produces a gap row or a CoverageRecord" is the checked acceptance shape (`sig-tasks statute-leads`).
- **The one-time auditor survey is modelled desk-research-only (SIG-INGEST-025b).** The CA State Auditor 2019-118 survey is a `state_auditor_survey` artifact with `capture_status = not_attempted` — the two registered source rows stay `ingestion_permitted=false` — and `recurrence_expected = false` enforced, plus a `searched_not_found` CoverageRecord for the absent follow-up naming the searched surfaces.
- **Legislative citations cite session and text or they do not publish (SIG-INGEST-025c).** `LegalInstrument` gains `session`/`text_ref` (vocab `2026.11.07-p37.14`) and `publish_verdict()` under `legal-instrument-publish/1`: a `statute`/`ordinance` citation withholds without a recorded session, every citation withholds unresolved-to-text; the verdict + reasons stamp the emitted `legal_instrument` record. The F2a-flagged session-less `SB 34` citation now evaluates `publishable=false`; the seed connector stamps `text_ref` from each v2 entry's verified `origin_url`.
- **The RecordsRequest→task link stays R11-K13-RQ-04's scope** — the leads feed the §36 queue; nothing is filed, drafted-for-send, fetched, or flipped.
